about: RL-13: what a run's Expedition and challenges change. expeditions: I first; each one's effect rows (logic/effects.js) join the run's Perks. The values are placeholders for the run sim. challenges: picked at the mast (any number) once its when-condition holds; each adds its rows and the rule its id names (logic/modifiers.js).

expeditions.name: Expedition I
expeditions.d: The first chapter. Foes as they come.

expeditions.name: Expedition II
expeditions.d: Foes 2 levels higher, the boss 15% tougher, prices 10% up.

expeditions.name: Expedition III
expeditions.d: Foes 4 levels higher, the boss 30% tougher, prices 20% up.

expeditions.name: Expedition IV
expeditions.d: Foes 6 levels higher, the boss 45% tougher, prices 30% up.

expeditions.name: Expedition V
expeditions.d: Foes 8 levels higher, the boss 60% tougher, prices 40% up.

mono.name: Mono-type
mono.d: Pick a type. Only Billies of it may start the run or be caught.

noheal.name: No healing
noheal.d: Clinics are closed, and no healing items are sold or packed.

noperks.name: No Perks
noperks.d: No Perk picks, and no Perks in shops.

fragile.name: Fainted is gone
fragile.d: A Billie that faints leaves the run after the battle.
